One ₹2,00,000 bucket shared by Travel EDGE, direct airline and direct hotel spends, flights and hotels together. "Per month" only; calendar vs statement not stated. Cap effective 20 Apr 2024.

Same clause as flights: 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on Travel EDGE, airline and hotel merchants up to ₹2,00,000 a month, 2 per ₹100 beyond. The ₹2,00,000 is one bucket shared with flights and direct airline and hotel spends.

Magnus for Burgundy FAQ: "Earn 60 EDGE Reward Points for every INR 200 spent on Travel EDGE portal, up to cumulative transactions of INR 2,00,000 per month. Earn 35 EDGE Reward Points per INR 200 spent above cumulative transactions of INR 2,00,000 per calendar month." Burgundy earns the "same as existing Magnus"; the Magnus catalog entry covers both. One ₹2,00,000 bucket shared by flights and hotels. The 35 beyond the cap holds only while general spends sit in the ₹1.5L to credit-limit-plus-₹1.5L accelerated band (effective 20 Jun 2025); otherwise 12.
Same clause as flights: 60 EDGE Reward Points per ₹200 on Travel EDGE up to ₹2,00,000 a calendar month, 35 beyond. One shared bucket for flights and hotels.

Rewards Marketplace T&C, table "Base + Accelerated Rewards": "HSBC Premier ... 6X (18 points per 100)". Cap clause: "HSBC Reward Points (accelerated points) are capped at 18,000 points per cardholder per calendar month." then "Base points will remain uncapped." So the cap counts the 15 bonus per ₹100, giving ₹1,20,000, not the sheet figure of ₹1,00,000. No daily cap anywhere. One 18,000 shared across flights, hotels and car rentals. Base 3/₹100 from the Premier page.

T&C: "HSBC Premier ... 12X (36 points per 100)"; accelerated points capped at 18,000 per calendar month, base uncapped. Bonus 33 per ₹100 gives ₹54,545, not the sheet figure of ₹50,000. No daily cap. Shared with flights and car rentals.

T&C: TravelOne "4X (16 points per 100)"; accelerated points capped at 18,000 per calendar month, base uncapped. TravelOne page: "Earn 4 reward points for every INR 100 spent on flights, travel aggregators and in foreign currency". Split confirmed by HSBC's TravelOne Value Calculator (travelone-value-calculator.pdf, Jul 2026): its Travel with Points line values ₹1,00,000 flights + ₹50,000 hotels + ₹20,000 cars at 22,800 points, which only reconciles as 12/20/4 per ₹100 over a base of 4, with the card's own 2X accelerator (50,000/month cap) counted on a separate line. HSBC states it nowhere in words.

T&C: TravelOne "6X (24 points per 100)"; accelerated points capped at 18,000 per calendar month, base uncapped. Base 4 for hotels is implied by 6X = 24, not stated on the card page. Split confirmed by HSBC's TravelOne Value Calculator, as for flights: 20 per ₹100 over a base of 4, the card's own 2X counted separately.

Ashva rewards T&C (May 2026): hotels earn +30 bonus per ₹150 (the sheet said +50); 15,000 bonus per calendar month, no daily cap. Base 10 per ₹150 above ₹20,000 in the cycle.
